name: What is the maintenance required for a shower seat?

mainEntity.name: What is the maintenance required for a shower seat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintenance for a shower seat primarily involves regular cleaning to prevent mold, mildew, and soap scum buildup, similar to the rest of your shower. The specific care depends on the material; for example, teak seats may benefit from occasional oiling to maintain their finish, while plastic or metal seats typically just need a wipe down with a mild cleaner. Inspecting hardware for wall-mounted seats annually ensures continued security and functionality. Proper maintenance extends the life of your shower seat and keeps your bathroom hygienic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance involves regular cleaning to prevent mold and soap scum. Specific care depends on the material, and annual hardware checks for wall-mounted seats.
